title: IREFOX Profound 400 review
notes: Exact reviewed build uses Shimano 105 R7000 mechanical 2×11, 50/34T crank, 11–34T cassette, cable-actuated hydraulic disc brakes with 160 mm rotors, aluminum wheels and Schwalbe 700×40C tires. The review describes 40C as the observed maximum and reports relaxed, stable, comfortable handling, but supplies no complete-bike weight or measured stiffness result. The 40C statement is not treated as a manufacturer maximum-clearance specification.
